title: Larry Smalley joins Ning Li; NASA capacitor patent

tellings.quote: but then we found out since that Larry Smalley who was the head of the physics department at University of Alabama Huntsville goes and joins her.

plain: Michels says that Larry Smalley, head of the physics department at the University of Alabama in Huntsville, went to join the physicist Ning Li in her work, and he connects this to a 2004 patent for an 'asymmetric bell-shaped capacitor' linked to NASA. Michels tells this himself, as something that came out later, in an episode with Dave Rossi, a man who says aliens taught him advanced physics. If true, a department head left a university post to work on unusual gravity-related physics.
